Description: No. 7 Victoria Maseko and No. 9 Helen Dauer talk in the Living room. Victoria says she feels unwell; Helen comforts her. They discuss the missing pocket watch, pregnancy experiences, and painful memories of war. After piano music begins, Helen leaves while Victoria stays.
Location: Living room（Living room）
Key Information:
  - No. 7 Victoria Maseko enters, greets No. 9 Helen Dauer, and says she feels unwell.
  - Victoria mentions she heard Helen’s pocket watch is missing; Helen comforts her and says it will be found.
  - Helen discusses pregnancy experiences, describing anxiety during her first pregnancy and mentioning her husband never returned from the front; Tony never met his father.
  - Victoria thanks Helen’s comfort and says she will tell her husband about it.
  - Piano music begins; Helen leaves the room, while Victoria remains.
Characters:
  [Victoria Maseko（Victoria Maseko）] Person No. 7, feeling unwell, seeks comfort while talking with Helen.
    · Says she feels unwell and thanks Helen for comforting her.
    · Discusses pregnancy and says she will tell her husband.
    · Expresses gratitude for Helen’s advice and comfort.
  [Helen Dauer（Helen Dauer）] Person No. 9, comforts Victoria and shares her pregnancy experience and war-time pain.
    · Talks about pregnancy and the pain caused by war, including the loss of her husband.
    · Comforts Victoria and says the watch will be found.
    · Leaves after piano music begins, hoping Victoria will be safe.
